components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, FiraGO, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: #1f5fbf; border: 2px solid #1f5fbf; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f5fbf; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action beside a primary, e.g. declining cookies.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, FiraGO, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); background: transparent; border: 2px solid var(--color-border, #dde3ec); border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #1f5fbf); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Circular glass button for GitHub, theme toggle and mobile menu.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); background: var(--glass-bg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.58)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75)); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #1f5fbf); border-color: var(--color-accent, #1f5fbf); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #1f5fbf); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Topic and article card floating over the light blobs.
components.html:
უსაფრთხოება

პირადი მონაცემების დაცვა, დიპფეიკების ამოცნობა და ხმის კლონირებით თაღლითობა.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 20rem; padding: 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, FiraGO, sans-serif); line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); background: var(--glass-bg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.58)); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75)); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9)), 0 10px 30px rgb(15 42 77 / 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgb(15 42 77 / 0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(180%); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9)), 0 16px 40px rgb(15 42 77 / 0.12); }

components.name: Pillar Tag
components.description: Non-interactive pill naming an article's pillar.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.1rem 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, FiraGO, sans-serif); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dde3ec); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Header links: muted by default, ink and bold on the current page.
components.html: მთავარისტატიებილექსიკონიპროექტის შესახებ
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, FiraGO, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--color-muted, #5a6578); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--color-text, #0f2a4d); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #1f5fbf); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AI Fluency looks out onto a complicated subject through clear glass: calm, honest, nothing hidden. The page is a soft morning ground lit by two diffuse pools of light, sky blue and amber, that drift behind everything. A few surfaces float above it as frosted glass: the sticky header, topic and article cards, and the consent banner. Everything a reader actually reads sits on the plain ground in one calm Georgian sans, at a comfortable measure.

The system is low-density and quiet. There is one typeface (FiraGO), two weights, one interactive color, and one warm accent that never carries text. Generous rounding and pill-shaped icon buttons make it soft and approachable for readers who aren't technical. The glass is the signature, and it stays special because there's little of it.

Both themes are first-class. Dark mode swaps the ground to night blue, lightens the interactive blue, and deepens the glass. It's a full counterpart, not an inverted afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted-glass header, cards and overlays over soft, fixed radial blobs of blue and amber.
One family, FiraGO, in Regular and Bold, self-hosted with a Georgian–Latin subset.
Reading text capped at 70ch on the plain ground, never on glass.
Sky blue is the only interactive color; amber is decoration only.
Light and dark themes are equally complete; transparency degrades to solid surfaces.

rules.name: The Amber Never Speaks Rule
rules.body: Amber is light, not language. It appears as the logo dot and a background glow, never as text, icons, links or a button fill.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Sky Blue means "you can act on this." Don't spend it on decoration, headings or fills that aren't interactive (the logo tile is the single brand exception).

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700 are loaded. Don't specify 500, 600 or italics; the browser would synthesize them.

rules.name: The Bold Is Enough Rule
rules.body: Georgian has no case, so emphasis never uses uppercase or letter-spacing. Use weight or Slate Muted for contrast.

rules.name: The Glass Is Signature Rule
rules.body: Glass is for the header, cards and overlays only. Long reading text, articles, the glossary and tables sit on the plain ground. A new surface earns glass only if it floats above content.

rules.name: The Clear Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every glass surface must fall back to a solid surface under prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce or without backdrop-filter support, with the blobs hidden, and text contrast must be identical either way.

dos: Do use the CSS custom properties (--color-*, --glass-*, --radius, --space, --measure) rather than literal values, so both themes follow automatically.
Do keep reading text on the plain ground at a 70ch measure, line-height 1.7.
Do give every glass surface a solid fallback for reduced transparency and for browsers without backdrop-filter.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem and keep the global 3px focus outline visible.
Do self-host every font and icon as SVG or WOFF; no CDNs.
Do check every new color pairing in both light and dark themes.
donts: Don't use Amber for text, icons, links or button fills.
Don't put articles, glossary entries or tables on glass.
Don't introduce a second typeface or weights other than 400 and 700.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spacing for emphasis.
Don't add motion beyond short state transitions; all animation and transitions are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
